item.title: The MacBook Air has a new chip and a lower price (sort of)
item.description: Macworld Apple today announced new MacBook Air laptops with the M5 processor and a range of other upgrades, as part of its ongoing “big week” of product reveals. Externally, there are very few differences from last year’s M4 Air, and aside from dropping in weight by a single gram has identical vital statistics. item.description: Macworld Apple on Tuesday introduced new laptops with new chips–and new prices, as well. item.title: macOS 26 Tahoe Beta: Latest beta and how to get it
item.description: Macworld Every year, Apple updates the Mac operating system. The beta process doesn’t stop with the full release of macOS in the fall.
